scientific_question: Within Lepidoptera, does out-of-species spatial-genetic transfer increase continuously with ecological similarity after geographic co-support is controlled?

baseline.name: within_lepidoptera_geography_conditioned_transfer
baseline.definition: For each evaluation species, predict post-IBD edge turnover from all geographically supported training Lepidoptera using the unchanged core TTF field and equal total species weight; score by Spearman correlation with target post-IBD turnover.
baseline.panel_statistic: arithmetic mean across response-blind supported evaluation species
baseline.role: second rung between the completed all-animal unconditional baseline and the trait-gradient estimand

trait_gradient.name: trait_similarity_transfer_gradient
trait_gradient.unit: target-source species pair within the target geographic support pool

trait_axes.wing_size: continuous log-scaled size proxy standardized within the frozen panel
trait_axes.habitat: Gower-style similarity over CanopyAffinity, EdgeAffinity, MoistureAffinity, DisturbanceAffinity

trait_gradient.composite_similarity: mean of available predeclared axis similarities after each axis is scaled to [0,1]; major-complete panel implies all four axes are present
trait_gradient.geographic_control: Residualize pairwise trait similarity against frozen response-blind geometry covariates within each target support pool before estimating the gradient.
trait_gradient.primary_statistic: Across target-source pairs, slope linking residualized trait similarity to source-specific transfer contribution, aggregated with equal total weight per evaluation target.
trait_gradient.positive_claim: Within Lepidoptera, ecologically more similar species share more reusable post-IBD spatial-genetic structure beyond geographic co-support.

private_null.shared_residual_field: none; each species receives an independent residual field

trait_gradient_positive.shared_residual_field: pairwise/shared component increases monotonically with frozen trait similarity while marginal private structure is retained

geometry_confounded_trap.shared_residual_field: shared amplitude depends only on response-blind geometry similarity; trait similarity is correlated with geometry but has no causal/shared-field role

stopping_rules: Do not inspect or compute empirical Lepidoptera nucleotide-identity transfer outcomes before all three synthetic cells pass.

Do not alter trait axes, composite rule, geographic covariates, support radius, coverage threshold, minimum source count, alpha, bootstrap count, or panel split after synthetic outcomes are inspected.
If any cell fails, retire this estimator version. Any replacement must receive a new estimator name/version and a new disjoint synthetic seed namespace.
Do not use the prior v0.2/v0.3 confirmatory geometry as the empirical confirmation panel for this new estimand.
